'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC female student found at night north of the {{Rubi|Solis Lens Array|Lahai-Roi Resonance Nexus}}, talking about "The Academy's 100 Great Mysteries" with her classmate, '''Ketahe'''.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Yukai:''' Supernatural stories are just "unexplained phenomena!"
:'''Yukai:''' Aren't you curious?

==Dialogue==
:'''Yukai:''' This is the forum! The home of campus ghost stories and urban legends!
:'''Ketahe:''' Wait, the Academy follows materialism, right? Why do we even have a supernatural forum?
:'''Yukai:''' They're just "unexplained phenomena!" Aren't you curious?
:'''Ketahe:''' You dragged me along because you were too scared to browse alone, didn't you...
:'''Yukai:''' Ahaha, well, it's more fun together!
:'''Ketahe:''' "Now in active production!!! The Academy's 100 Great Mysteries!" You can just tell this is from some [[Ashinohara]] students...
:'''Yukai:''' "The Creepy Traffic Illuminator Chasing Students on the Highway"?
:{{DIcon}} (Sounds like [[S.I.G.M.A.]]...)
:'''Yukai:''' "The Moving Nurse Mannequin in the Infirmary"?
:{{DIcon}} (That's definitely [[N.A.N.A.]]...)
:'''Yukai:''' "The Cyber-Ghost Girl Crawling Out of Screens"?
:{{DIcon}} ([[I.R.I.S.]] would lose it.)
:'''Yukai:''' "The Mindbending Herder"?
:{{DIcon}} ([[Zahira]]...)
:'''Yukai:''' "The Midnight Phantom Shuttle Bus" ...? Is this Academy really safe?
:{{DIcon}} And there are still 95 mysteries left, remember?
:'''Yukai:''' AHHHHHH—Don't sneak up on me like that!
:'''Ketahe:''' Why are you screaming that loud?! You scared me too!
{{Dialogue End}}
